messages:
kelly (acct-manager): Hey team — ACME reported a failed invoice payment (INV-20284). Card was declined by gateway with response 'flagged' and code 310. Customer says they completed the 3DS challenge in their browser but the payment still failed. I tried a quick repro on our side and see the same decline. Link to charge: https://console.reddemo/invoices/INV-20284/payments/pm_3xXx. Need guidance on next steps and whether this is SCA-related or an acquirer fraud hold.

samira (support): Thanks @kelly. Can you paste the payment_request_id and the gateway response body? Also last4/bin would help for acquirer lookup. Any screenshots of the ACS flow? :thinking_face:

kelly (acct-manager): payment_request_id: pr_8b9c2f, gateway_response: {"status":"decline","code":310,"reason":"flagged"}. PAN last4: 4242, bin: 424242. Customer says ACS returned success, they saw bank 'authentication successful' page then got redirected back to app with a spinner and eventual failure. I attached a short screen recording to the ticket.

raj (payments): Code 310 from TransactX typically maps to 'suspected_fraud' on the acquirer side. It can be an acquirer-enforced hold even after SCA success. Two things: 1) confirm that we forwarded the ACS result to the gateway (we do a separate auth after 3DS), 2) check whether our post-3DS auth call is missing the `eci`/`three_ds_result` fields. If those are missing, some acquirers treat it as non-authenticated and decline.

liam (eng): I pulled the logs for pr_8b9c2f — our frontend is posting the `three_ds_result` token to /v1/payments/confirm but the backend endpoint is dropping `three_ds_result` if the JSON payload size exceeds 8kb (we had a validation middleware bug). Repro: curl -X POST https://api.reddemo/v1/payments/confirm -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"payment_request_id":"pr_8b9c2f","three_ds_result":"<long_token>"}' and check server log: `WARN middleware: validation error -> payload truncated`.

liam (eng): Quick fix: bump payload validation size to 16kb or accept `three_ds_result` as form param. I'll open a PR and deploy a patch to staging.

repro-bot: Reproducer created: https://repro.reddemo/builds/rep-2023-310 (contains curl scripts and screen capture).

raj (payments): Good catch @liam. If the post-3DS auth is missing the three_ds_result/eci, the acquirer may consider the auth incomplete and flag it. Once the backend fix is live, we should resubmit the auth (a new auth attempt) — but note the acquirer may require a different merchant reference to avoid duplicate suppression. I'll start an acquirer ticket with TransactX and share the reference: TX-CASE-7591.

samira (support): Action plan: 1) @liam push the validation-size patch to staging and ping qa. 2) @raj open acquirer support ticket (TX-CASE-7591) and ask for hold lift after re-auth. 3) @kelly ask the customer to retry with another card temporarily or wait for confirmation from us before reattempting. I'll update the support ticket and set status: escalated -> payments.

kelly (acct-manager): Thanks all — I've told the customer to hold off retrying until we confirm. I'll update them with the TransactX case number and the repro link. :thumbsup:

liam (eng): PR opened: https://git.reddemo/reddemo/payments/commit/9f3a1b3. Will deploy a hotfix to staging in ~10m and to prod after QA signoff.

samira (support): Marking thread for follow-up: please post post-deploy test results here and we will coordinate customer follow-up. Thanks everyone! :white_check_mark:
